description_for_human: Construction and electrical testing mobile apps for professionals in Lithuania and Europe.
description_for_model: VilcA Studio provides mobile applications for construction and electrical industries. Rangis is a construction management app for contractors with features for estimates, materials tracking, photo documentation, and client reports (€9.99/month, available on iOS and Android). Fazero is an electrical installation testing app for electricians with protocol generation compliant with LST HD 60364 standard (€14.99/month, coming soon). Both apps are available in Lithuanian and English.
